newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes flat at an intraday low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes flat at an intraday low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed unchanged at an intraday low of 8.2926 in slow trade in Shanghai on Tuesday against the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
Tbe weighted average price on Monday was 8.2924.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2921 and moved steadily around the 8.2920 level for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2914.

"A wait-and-see attitude dominates the market today," said one dealer. "Fresh buying emerged at the lower level to support the yuan's upward trend, but intervention from the central bank prevented any further rises."
A second dealer said the level of intervention was lower than expected.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to consolidate in the range of 8.2920 and 8.2930 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed down at 6.6540 from 6.6460 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0705 from 1.0706 against the Hong Kong dollar.
